description: This file defines a class AWSTestConstants used for testing AWS services such as DynamoDB in the Orleans.AWSUtils project. It includes logic to check DynamoDB availability by attempting to initialize a table, and exposes configuration properties for AWS credentials and service endpoints.

classes.name: AWSTestConstants
